data.description:
Modify cortical/got/expression/executor.py to detect and execute standalone FunctionCalls.

Current behavior: 'got expr blocked()' fails with 'Function calls cannot be used as filter expressions'
Expected behavior: Should execute the blocked() function and return results

Changes needed:
1. In execute() method, check if query.expression is a FunctionCall
2. If so, call new _execute_function_call() method
3. Implement _execute_function_call() using existing _apply_function() logic

Files to modify:
- cortical/got/expression/executor.py (lines 34-75)

Test:
- got expr 'blocked()' should return blocked tasks
- got expr 'recent(7)' should return recent tasks
data.title: Fix executor to handle top-level FunctionCall expressions
